speaker: character
text: The council just cut our grant in half. We can't pay for the room or the lunches, and the deposit is due Friday. I think we have to cancel.

speaker: candidate
text: If the money is gone, the workshop is gone. Let's just call it off.

speaker: character
text: So what do we do? We have half the money and seven days.

speaker: candidate
text: I don't know, you're the treasurer. Maybe it will sort itself out.

speaker: character
text: Everyone's panicking in the chat. Madi and Sara say they're out if we're going to fail anyway.

speaker: candidate
text: If they want to quit, let them. We'll manage without them.

speaker: character
text: If we can't do everything, what do we protect?

speaker: candidate
text: We promised everything, so we keep everything. Cutting anything would look bad.

speaker: character
text: Sixty kids signed up and we have thirty seats. How do we choose?

speaker: candidate
text: Let's not tell the others they're out. They'll figure it out.

speaker: character
text: Okay. The deposit is due Friday. What exactly do we do before then?

speaker: candidate
text: Let's all try our best this week and see how it goes.

speaker: character
text: The university room fell through. All we can get is a small room for twenty people. Now what?

speaker: candidate
text: That's it, we cancel. I told you this wouldn't work.
